Hi Chris —

Great to be moving forward on the POC. I wanted to propose a kickoff + hands-on working session where we can:
- do a short intro of teams and success criteria (10m)
- walk through the POC plan and mutual action items (10m)
- hands-on prompt review + routing config (25m)
- run a brief load test / throughput check (10m)
- action items and next steps (5m)

Total 60 minutes. Proposed slots next week (PT):
- Tue 2026-04-14 10:00–11:00
- Wed 2026-04-15 13:00–14:00
- Thu 2026-04-16 09:00–10:00

Please let me know which works or share a couple of alternatives. If helpful, we can split into a shorter kickoff (30m) and a separate hands-on session — happy to adapt to your calendar.

I've attached a tentative agenda and will create a calendar invite once we lock a time. Vivek (cc'd) will lead the prompt/routing and load test work; Laura will be the CS touchpoint for success criteria and logistics.

Thanks — talk soon.

—Marissa

Attached is an updated agenda that adds 10 minutes to prompt review and explicitly lists roles. We'll plan the session like this:
- Introductions (Marissa, 10m) — attendees & success criteria
- POC plan + mutual action items (Vivek, 10m)
- Prompt review & routing (Vivek, 35m) — live edits and test cases
- Load test (Vivek, 15m) — brief burst + quick analysis
- Wrap + next steps (Laura, 5m)

Attachments: BrightMode_Redwood_POC_Agenda.pdf
